rendering: bold 2D cartoon, thick uniform outlines, flat colour fills, minimal shading, exaggerated expressions and poses, clean vector look
camera: simple staging: medium shots, straight-on or slight angle, occasional extreme close-up for comedy beats, no depth of field
lighting: flat, no cast shadows except a soft ground shadow
character_design_rules: Simple geometric bodies, one silhouette and one colour per character, dot or oval eyes, signature items drawn as bold shapes. Line weight identical everywhere.
environment_rules: minimal backgrounds with 2–3 props, flat horizon, patterned textures allowed
negative_prompt: 3D, photorealistic, gradients, painterly, sketchy lines, anime

palette.palette_line: flat saturated primaries, cream paper background

tier1.summary: pan_lr and hold preferred, push_in ≤ 1.05, 30 fps

motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix: snappy 2D animation, limited frames feel, bouncy motion
motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix_v2: snappy 2D animation, limited frames feel, bouncy expressive motion, clear gestures, lively faces

typography.subtitle_style: dark navy on cream pill background, highlight #FF6B6B
